sourceInspection.checked: Inspected loadDataset, loadPrompts, buildRequest, validateResponse, batchPlans, score, createSnapshot, validateSaved, validateResult and main.
sourceInspection.observed: Snapshots bind canonical dataset/labels, targets, prompts, model, mode, threshold and batch size. Each saved response is matched to the reconstructed request and valid probability answers. Completion requires every planned batch. Classification uses noul >= threshold.
sourceInspection.consequence: The offline API checks exercise the public input and scoring boundaries for every saved run.

sourceInspection.checked: Inspected readDocument, readDocuments and datasetHashes with the JSON schema.
sourceInspection.observed: Validation checks metadata schema, raw text checksum, sample ranges, duplicate IDs/checks and exact snippet inclusion. Samples are resolved into labeled targets without altering disk labels.
sourceInspection.consequence: Current balanced cohort and score assertions use the unchanged labeled passages.

sourceInspection.checked: Inspected sentence segmentation and offset preservation.
sourceInspection.observed: The public loader builds sentence ranges from each intact target. These runs use classification-only requests.

sourceInspection.checked: Inspected native child spawn, input hashes, word limit, SDK checks, exit event, receipt write and parent completion.
sourceInspection.observed: Every new-check receipt matches this driver hash and its original job and log.
sourceInspection.consequence: The original native child provenance is mechanically verified.

evaluationBoundary.labelTruth: Known label corrections await separate curation, as reported by main. Current datasets and labels remain unchanged.
evaluationBoundary.agreement: Detector agreement is used only for mechanical scoring against current labels.
evaluationBoundary.repeatedTotals: Caught, missed, false-positive and true-negative totals sum repeated decisions across saved runs. Distinct passage/check judgments and distinct passages are counted separately.
evaluationBoundary.mixedCohorts: Mixed cohorts are scored per named check. This audit reports per-check errors and preserves their passage IDs.

priorInvalidatedReview.incident: The earlier review emitted extra Git tuning metadata and was invalidated.
priorInvalidatedReview.disposition: This fresh session repeated the mechanical checks with purpose-filtered Git output. The prior incident remains historical evidence in Git.

operations: Load each exact development file through the public schema/text/range/snippet validation boundary.
Load each current named prompt and verify the assembled hash, intended cutoff and full word count.
Reconstruct and deep-compare every public snapshot; validate each result as complete, including request and inference hashes.
Deep-compare every original score with the preserved summary; rescore saved probabilities at the intended cutoff in memory.
Compare all 51 prior twelve-check runs and four fixed-metaphor runs with the permitted audits.
Compare ten new-check original jobs, executions, logs, registered source hashes, SDK identity and hash-matching driver.
Capture the two permitted Git JSON blobs in code and project only the intended calibration entry; verify registration excerpts and timestamp ordering.
Check all previously read source bytes remain unchanged before writing only the requested audit.

runtimeDependencyReadScope.purpose: Transitive library loading by the permitted public runner and checksum/version inspection of the SDK sources explicitly named in execution receipts.

preliminaryReadCoverage: The named instructions, writing references, permitted verifier, manifest, public sources, audits, registration excerpts, original job/execution inventories and native driver read during source inspection are also recorded by this verifier.
